=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:1284-1300, 1351-1383 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The base-tracked skip is keyed to the workflow and the workflow-level conclusion of main's newest push run. It does not match the failing job or failure to the heal issue, so a distinct PR failure can be suppressed and get no per-PR triage issue.
  WHY: The collect stage exits before diagnosis, so the PR failure gets no per-PR issue or owner. Severity: both reviewers rated it MAJOR, mapped here to high.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:1299-1301 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The base conclusion is read from only the single newest push run (`per_page=1`, `.workflow_runs[0]`), so job-level results on main are not visible.
  WHY: The gate can read "failure" for a workflow whose failing job differs from the PR's failing job. This is the same root cause as the first finding, seen from the read side.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:694 (base-tracked-note stage, approximate) | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The note stage reads existing heal comments, checks for the marker, then posts. The check and the post are not atomic.
  WHY: A re-run of the same PR that races with the first run could post two notes with the same marker. Reported as NIT.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:1362-1367, 1384-1388 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The heal lookup failure and the metadata write failure both fail open to filing a per-PR issue.
  WHY: The reviewer said this is the intended fail-open and not a defect, noted only so the reader knows the gate does not drop failures on these paths. Reported as NIT.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:triage_base_failure_heal_issue (around line 660) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The lookup reads only the oldest 100 open ai:workflow-heal issues (per_page=100, sort=created ascending), so a matching heal issue beyond the first page is not found.
  WHY: The gate at line 1390 falls through to filing a per-PR issue, which creates a duplicate and does not lose the failure. Reported as NIT.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:triage_base_failure_heal_issue jq filter | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: A stuck or escalated heal issue keeps the ai:workflow-heal label, so the skip still treats it as tracking.
  WHY: The PR failure is suppressed while the heal issue is not progressing. Whether that is acceptable depends on the heal lifecycle, which the reviewer did not verify. Reported as NIT.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:"Handle blocked planning output" step; prompts/mode-judge-unblock.txt:53 | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The step chooses the "waiting on open PR" comment and the WARNING page from the reason text, but the unblock judge can return any of four wait kinds (pr_on_branch, item_closed, placeholder_retired, pr_check_green).
  WHY: For a non-pr_on_branch wait the issue is told it is waiting on an open PR, and nothing resumes it because the PR-merge trigger does not apply. Reported as MAJOR, conditional on the judge returning a non-pr_on_branch wait.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2347-2350, 2352-2381 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The wait message and WARNING page are disabled only when `UNBLOCK_JUDGE_ENABLED` is false, and they ignore `UNBLOCK_JUDGE_WAIT_ENABLED`.
  WHY: When `UNBLOCK_JUDGE_WAIT_ENABLED=false`, `unblock_judge.yml` passes `--wait-disabled`, so the judge cannot place the issue on the PR-merge hold that the message promises.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: stop per-PR triage issues for a failure that main already tracks
  expected_change_site: scripts/check_failure_triage.sh, lines 1351-1393 (base gate)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The skip is workflow-level only, and the check or job name that failed on the PR is not compared with the heal issue's failing job, so a PR failure that main does not share at job level is still suppressed.
